intro.en: With over 1.5 years of QA experience, I test web, mobile, and API workflows from requirements through defect follow-up. The DemoQA case study below illustrates the testing process step by step.
intro.vi: Với hơn 1,5 năm kinh nghiệm QA, tôi kiểm thử các luồng Web, Mobile và API từ phân tích yêu cầu đến theo dõi lỗi. Case study DemoQA bên dưới minh họa từng bước của quy trình kiểm thử.

summary.en: At Laztar Software Company, I worked on requirement analysis, test design, functional and regression testing, and defect follow-up with developers.
summary.vi: Tại Laztar Software Company, tôi tham gia phân tích yêu cầu, thiết kế ca kiểm thử, kiểm thử chức năng và hồi quy, đồng thời theo dõi lỗi cùng lập trình viên.

description.en: Tested OCR, camera and voice translation, subscription flows, language switching, and compatibility across Android devices.
description.vi: Kiểm thử OCR, dịch bằng camera và giọng nói, luồng đăng ký gói, chuyển ngôn ngữ và khả năng tương thích trên nhiều thiết bị Android.

planSections.title: Purpose and Objectives
items: Demonstrate structured manual testing: planning, designing test cases, executing, reporting bugs, and tracking test data.
Provide artifacts suitable for interviews and initial team contributions.

planSections.title: Scope
items: In-scope: Core interactive UI elements (forms, buttons, links), basic workflows (form submission, file upload/download), input validation, navigation and accessibility checks.
Out-of-scope: Performance, security, and extensive cross-browser matrix (can be added later).

planSections.title: Test Approach
items: Manual test cases organized by type: Smoke, Functional, Regression.
Exploratory testing during test execution to discover edge cases.
Use sample test data in test_data.csv.

planSections.title: Test Items
items: Text Box (Forms)
Buttons
Links (including broken links)
File upload/download
Checkboxes and radio buttons

planSections.title: Test Types
items: Smoke: basic sanity checks to ensure major flows work.
Functional: feature-level tests for expected behavior.
Regression: re-run critical tests after fixes.

planSections.title: Entry Criteria
items: Demo site accessible and stable.
Test cases reviewed.

planSections.title: Exit Criteria
items: All smoke tests pass.
No P0/P1 open defects.
Test execution records updated.

planSections.title: Risks and Mitigations
items: Demo site instability: schedule testing during low-traffic windows and document intermittent failures.
Incomplete requirements: adopt exploratory testing and document assumptions.

planSections.title: Reporting
items: Use BUG_REPORT_TEMPLATE.md for issues.
Store execution results in SAMPLE_TEST_EXECUTION_REPORT.csv.

planSections.title: How I'd extend this
items: Add automation (suggested stack: JavaScript + Playwright) for smoke/regression tests.
Add GitHub Actions CI to run automation on push and PRs.
Add HTML/JUnit reporting and Docker-based test runner for reproducible runs.
